text:
## Abstract
The objective was to identify the sequencing platform and the organism associated with GEO Series GSE309890. We queried the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) using its Series-level metadata endpoint to retrieve the record for GSE309890, including platform, organism, experiment type, and links to processed data files. The query returned one Series record with platform accession GPL24659 and the organism specified as Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. The study is categorized as “Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing” and lists 6 samples. No PubMed links are registered for this record at the time of retrieval. The processed expression values are available only via the GEO FTP supplementary directory. These results directly answer the platform and organism questions by reporting values from the GEO record’s “platform” and “taxon” fields. Determining these attributes is essential for downstream reproducibility, platform-specific processing decisions, and organism-specific interpretation of gene expression profiles.

## I. Introduction
Background. The NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) archives processed gene expression studies under Series accessions (GSE). Each Series records key metadata including the platform (GPL) used and the study’s organism, which are required to interpret and replicate analyses.

Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.

Knowledge Gap. The platform and organism associated with GSE309890 were not stated in the question and needed to be resolved from authoritative metadata.

Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: Retrieve the sequencing platform and organism for GEO Series GSE309890. Hypothesis: The GEO Series metadata record for GSE309890 contains explicit fields for platform (GPL accession) and organism (taxon string).

## II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. We used GEO’s Series metadata retrieval to obtain authoritative platform and organism details for GSE309890, because GEO is the primary curated source for these fields.

Materials.
- NCBI GEO, accessed via functions.geo_series.

Procedures.
- Tool call: functions.geo_series with arguments accession="GSE309890", list_files=true to retrieve the Series metadata and supplementary file links.

Statistical Analysis.
- No statistical analysis was required. The platform accession and organism were taken directly from the returned record fields: platform and taxon. The sample_count value (6) was read as a simple field without transformation or deduplication.

## III. Results
Findings.
- Platform: GPL24659 (from the “platform” field of the GSE309890 record).
- Organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 (from the “taxon” field of the GSE309890 record).
- Experiment type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing.
- Sample count: 6.

## IV. Discussion
Interpretation. The GEO Series record for GSE309890 reports platform GPL24659 and organism Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655, meeting the objective to identify both attributes.

Context. The study is annotated as RNA-seq-based expression profiling with 6 samples, consistent with the platform and organism metadata retrieved. No PubMed IDs are registered for this Series, indicating no linked publication in GEO at the time of query.

Limitations. GEO’s API provides metadata only; processed expression values must be retrieved from the supplementary FTP directory. The record lists only the platform accession (GPL24659); detailed platform characteristics (e.g., exact instrument or library preparation specifics) would require retrieving the GPL record itself.

Conclusion & Future Directions. GSE309890 was run on platform GPL24659 in Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. A next query worth running is to fetch the GPL24659 platform record for detailed platform specifications and, if needed, to download the supplementary expression matrix from the GEO FTP directory for local analysis.

## References
[1] NCBI GEO — GSE309890 record: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890
[2] NCBI GEO FTP — Series directory: https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/
[3] NCBI GEO FTP — Supplementary file (processed values): https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/suppl/GSE309890_FPKMs_allSamples.csv.gz

## Acknowledgments
We acknowledge NCBI GEO and NCBI E-utilities for data access.
